title: Update on Enhancements to Single Room Shared Facilities Initiative
what_it_is: Update on Enhancements to Single Room Shared Facilities Initiative

sections.label: HDB refurbishing former Anderson hostel
sections.summary: HDB is refurbishing the former Anderson Junior College hostel for the pilot, with applications opening in December 2023.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: The Housing and Development Board (HDB) is currently refurbishing the premises at the former Anderson Junior College hostel to prepare for the pilot and applications will open in December 2023.

sections.label: Pilot capacity and scaling up
sections.summary: The pilot will accommodate up to 480 single rooms, and scaling up will wait until the pilot runs its course.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The second question that the Member asked is when can this be scaled up.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: This pilot will allow us to accommodate up to a maximum of some 480 single rooms; that is, 480 individuals.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: But as to when this can be scaled up, I think we will let the pilot run its course first.

sections.label: Appeals for pilot units
sections.summary: Individuals with strong cases are encouraged to apply for the pilot unit when it opens in December this year.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
sentences.text: I understand as well that it is currently a pilot scheme, but I am wondering if we have residents that come in to our Meet-the-People sessions and specifically, in our assessment, we feel that they have a strong case, is this something that we can formally make an appeal for?

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Certainly, I encourage individuals who would like to apply for this pilot unit to do so when we open it in December this year.

sections.label: Engagement on pilot concerns
sections.summary: Engagement with organisations, professionals, academics and researchers raised concerns about infrastructure, social interaction, loneliness, social services and community building for the pilot.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Indeed, in the run-up to the announcement of this pilot, as I said, last year, we had engaged a wide range of organisations, professionals, academics and researchers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: And there were concerns about the infrastructural side of the house – how to maintain, how to upkeep, how would we account for the usage of utilities; very practical stuff.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: There were also a lot of people who were concerned about how the pilot site or how the set-up of any future model would enable social interaction as you move to a single unit kind of typology, where you can stay in the room the whole day if you want and not interact; how do you combat the loneliness and social isolation, particularly, given that many of these individuals who will stay there are often victims of circumstances who have difficulties in life and we do not want them to be entirely isolated.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Some were also concerned about how social services and community organisations could make use of the spaces to engage, to draw out the tenants and to be able to provide more holistic support for them.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: And in the spirit of what we have been doing in ComLink, there was also this suggestion about how a more integrated support could be provided for the tenants of this rental housing typology which, of course, will be of relevance not just to this but other rental pilots as well.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: There was, of course, feedback about how community organisations could be brought in to help build community – help to organise activities for the tenants, help to build a sense of community ownership and community spirit amongst the tenants, how volunteers would come in and do community art, alongside the residents.
